system.description: Expend one Spell Slot when you initiate Bloodstep. Every turn that you maintain Focus on Blood Step, you may expense 1D10 HP to leave a spot of blood on the ground. Mark it on the map. As a Boost to a move action when you are on a point marked with blood, you may move to another point marked by your blood on the map. You may not take other creatures with you when you do this.
